mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (id, course_id, student_id, coach_id, action, status, create_time, update_time, delete_flag) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{coachId}, #{action}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reservations WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE reservations SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = 0
